cards.back: Our home planet. People, animals and plants live on it.

cards.back: A big, hot star. It gives us light and heat.

cards.back: The Earth is round like a ball.

cards.back: It gives us light and heat. Without it nothing could live.
cards.say: Why is the Sun important? It gives us light and heat. Without it nothing could live.

cards.front: Does the Sun give us light?
cards.back: Yes. The Sun lights up our days.
cards.say: Does the Sun give us light? Yes. The Sun lights up our days.

cards.front: Does the Sun give us heat?
cards.back: Yes. The Sun keeps the Earth warm.
cards.say: Does the Sun give us heat? Yes. The Sun keeps the Earth warm.

cards.back: Yes. Plants need sunlight to grow.
cards.say: Do plants need the Sun? Yes. Plants need sunlight to grow.

cards.front: Is the Sun hot or cold?
cards.back: The Sun is very, very hot.
cards.say: Is the Sun hot or cold? The Sun is very, very hot.

cards.front: Is the Sun close to the Earth?
cards.back: No. The Sun is very far away.
cards.say: Is the Sun close to the Earth? No. The Sun is very far away.

cards.front: Should we look straight at the Sun?
cards.back: No. It can hurt our eyes. Never look at the Sun.
cards.say: Should we look straight at the Sun? No. It can hurt our eyes. Never look at the Sun.

cards.front: What can we wear to stay safe in the hot Sun?
cards.back: A hat, sun cream and light clothes.
cards.say: What can we wear to stay safe in the hot Sun? A hat, sun cream and light clothes.

cards.front: Is most of the Earth covered by land or water?
cards.back: Water. There is more sea than land.
cards.say: Is most of the Earth covered by land or water? Water. There is more sea than land.

cards.front: What do we use air for?
cards.back: We need air to breathe.
cards.say: What do we use air for? We need air to breathe.

cards.front: When do we see the Sun in the sky?
cards.back: In the daytime.
cards.say: When do we see the Sun in the sky? In the daytime.

cards.front: Which gives light in the day: the Sun or the Moon?
cards.back: The Sun. The Moon is not a star and has no light of its own.
